memories.content: Harborview Credit Union has a policy for handling card disputes. It received Marisol's dispute today. It may provisionally credit disputed amounts within ten business days, subject to its internal review process.

Marisol filed a dispute with Harborview Credit Union today (2026-10-14) regarding a $320 charge on her card. She was quoted a ten-business-day window for provisional credit. The ten-business-day window ends on 2026-10-28 (excluding weekends and the federal holiday on 2026-10-12? Actually 2026-10-14 is a Wednesday, so ten business days later is 2026-10-28, a Wednesday). The credit union has the ability to provisionally credit the amount within that window.
